title: Virtua Fighter CG Portrait Series Vol. 9: Kage Maru
native_title: バーチャ・ファイター ＣＧポートレート・シリーズ Ｖｏｌ．９ 「影丸」
overview:
Character CG from Virtua Fighter and an image song blend together beautifully...

Volume 9 of the CG Portrait Series is devoted to the ninja Kage-Maru. Newly made computer graphics show him striking from the shadows of a traditional Japanese house and, unmasked, among modern city towers, in a sequence staged to his image song "Dare mo Shiranai", a single from the Virtua Fighter 2 vocal album Dancing Shadows.

Choose "Karaoke" and the lyrics appear on screen so you can sing along.

- Original CG portraits of Kage-Maru
- Image song with a karaoke mode

「バーチャファイター」のキャラクターCGとイメージソングが華麗に融合する…
